absent: Numeric values of clone levels, page masks, sizes, and flag helpers for table walking.
Layouts of entry area, scratch stack, fixup range, vsyscall, and kernel image symbols.
Implementation of user table walk allocators, memory global setters, and checker helpers.
Semantics of table disabled and bad marking, APIC validity, node mapping, and UV types.
Semantics of bus mapping, port access, trace print, lockdown, and grace synchronization.
Full translation state structures, identifier allocation, tagging masks, and IPI dispatch.
Callers, ordering, and build selection among alternate fragments for 32 bit and feature cases.

findings.text: Boot isolation exposes early setup and late completion operations plus NUMA association parsers for processor affinity records as cross module entry operations.

Early isolation setup runs only when processor reports the isolation capability and otherwise returns silently; when active it shares platform areas, normalizes global markings, shares entry code while still writable, and prepares platform fixups.
Late completion runs after init memory release and read only transition, resharing entry code in its final split form, sharing part of kernel image when eligible, and validating user mappings.

Address range cloning walks kernel tables from top levels toward leaves, advancing past empty upper entries by rounding forward to next boundary, sharing either whole leaf tables at coarse granularity or individual entries at fine granularity, requiring presence of source entries, marking shared entries global when hardware supports that attribute, aborting on missing top entries or unexpected absent leaf entries or invalid granularity, and stopping on wrap of the cursor.

User table sharing includes copying a fourth level entry at a given virtual address when the user slot exists, plus two variants for shared areas with one copying that level plus per processor scratch mappings derived from physical translation and another cloning a fixed sized entry region at coarse granularity, plus conditional fixup cloning and entry code cloning parameterized by lateness.

Shared global kernel image is allowed only when four negative conditions all hold concerning process context identifiers, automatic mode selection, absence of an older AMD quirk, and disabled structure layout randomization; when allowed, initial global markings over the aligned image are cleared then partially restored for text and read only portions while secrets beyond read only data stay unshared.

Proximity association handling ignores input when firmware table support is disabled or record is not enabled, treats malformed record size as table failure, translates proximity identifier to node with overflow treated as failure, selects APIC identifier differently on large UV systems, skips identifiers beyond local APIC limit, otherwise records APIC to node association and marks node in parsed sets with diagnostic output; NUMA startup delegates to generic init and reports invalid when disabled.

Memory mapped trace self test defines small arithmetic progressions for narrow and wide values and exercises three access widths over disjoint offsets with a separate distant read, counting mismatches per width and emitting trace diagnostics.

Module startup enforces lockdown policy, requires a nonzero bus address parameter, warns about destructive overwrite of mapped space, maps a size chosen by far offset presence, runs functional plus repeated map unmap stress followed by grace period synchronization, and logs completion; unload only logs.
Small descriptor packs a sixteen bit address space identifier with a single bit flush request; global context counter starts at one.
Speculation control bits for last user context use value one for indirect branch barrier request and value two for cache flush request with combined mask and initial value equal to barrier request.
Available identifier bits equal hardware width minus bits consumed by isolation with consumption one when isolation enabled else zero; maximum usable identifier derives from that width minus two.
Global identifier allocator tracks last used global value and remaining count derived from maximum minus dynamic slots minus one, with last counter initialized to maximum.

Context management exposes operations to leave current user context for initial context, switch contexts under interrupt guard, borrow a temporary context with breakpoint handling, restore prior context while clearing flush need, reinitialize per processor state, query current page table base, and dispatch remote flushes.

Temporary context borrow and release both require disabled preemption and hold interrupt guard across the switch, leaving lazy mode before borrowing and clearing current processor from flush mask before restoring; context switch wrapper holds interrupt save across the inner off variant.

Processor state initialization validates that hardware base references loaded tables, that address tagging is disabled, and that process identifier enable matches capability, then forces untagged base with zero identifier and flush, reinitializes speculation marker and identifier slots and generation tracking and tagging masks.

Remote flush need is false for lazy processors, true for kernel only requests or switching state or matching loaded context or when trimming membership, otherwise false with ordering between loaded context and lazy flag; dispatch always broadcasts when tables were freed or address space in transition else uses conditional broadcast, with accounting and tracing differentiated by full versus ranged size.

Local helpers include counting remote receipt then flushing all, flushing kernel ranges page by page with kernel invalidation, rebuilding expected page table base from loaded tables plus identifier plus tagging mask with strict calling context checks, forcing a bus fault from callback, and refreshing privilege enable from loaded context on current processor.

Single page flush ceiling defaults to thirty three and resides in rarely written storage; flush helper linkage is empty under paravirtualization else static with direct mapping to native local and global operations.

Trace test logging prefixes messages with module name, bus address defaults to zero, distant read offset defaults to four megabytes plus two hundred fifty six, bulk stress repeats mapping ten times over one page.

Failure handling aborts range cloning on missing top entries or absent leaf entries or invalid granularity, warns on unaligned holes and on missing user slots, treats malformed firmware records and proximity overflow as table failure, warns about performance loss for thirty two bit isolation on sixty four bit capable hardware, warns about destructive bus overwrite, and assumes worst case flush during switching.

Isolation moves from disabled through early shared state with writable entry code to finalized state with split entries and partial image sharing; translation context moves among lazy, switching sentinel, and loaded states with lazy deferring flush until next switch and switching forcing flush; firmware parsing moves from enabled to disabled or bad on malformed input.
